segments.text: Hi, I'm Eben, known as ThatWeb3Guy on X. This is Cascade, built on the Buffer API.
If you post every day, you know the routine. One idea, rewritten for every network, then pasted into Buffer one channel at a time.
Cascade does that step for you.
I connect my Buffer account, and my real channels load straight from Buffer's API.
I write the idea once, the way I'd say it.
I add a photo, and Cascade checks that Buffer can fetch it.
Then I choose where it goes.
Cascade writes a version for each network.
Each post fits its channel, counted the way Buffer counts it. My X Premium limit is read from my channel.
It keeps my words, my links and my tags, and never adds hashtags or emojis I didn't write.
I can edit anything, or ask for a fresh version.
For each channel I choose: the queue, a time in that channel's time zone, or a draft.
One tap saves my original idea to Buffer Ideas, then creates one post per channel.
If anything fails, Cascade says why in plain words, and retries only what's missing.
One idea. Every channel. Ready in Buffer. That's Cascade, at oncascade dot vercel dot app.
